verses.en: And it came to pass after this, that David enquired of the LORD, saying, Shall I go up into any of the cities of Judah? And the LORD said unto him, Go up. And David said, Whither shall I go up? And he said, Unto Hebron.
verses.sm: Iuta Mulimuli ane ua fesili aru Tavita i le ALII, ua faapea atu, Ou te alu ae ea i se tasi aai o Iuta? Ua fetalai mai ai le ALII ia te. ia, Ina alu ae ia. Ua fai atu Tavita, O le fea aai ou te alu ae i ai? Ona fetalai mai lea o ia, o Heperona.

verses.en: So David went up thither, and his two wives also, Ahinoam the Jezreelitess, and Abigail Nabal's wife the Carmelite.
verses.sm: Ona alu ae lea o Tavita i ai, o ia atoa ma ana aya e toalua, o Ainoama le Isereelu, ma Apikaila le aya a Napalu le Karamelu.

verses.en: And his men that were with him did David bring up, every man with his household: and they dwelt in the cities of Hebron.
verses.sm: O ona tagata foi sa ia te ia na O ae i latou ma Tavita, e taitasi ma lona aiga; ua latou nonofo i aai O Heperona.

verses.en: And the men of Judah came, and there they anointed David king over the house of Judah. And they told David, saying, That the men of Jabesh-gilead were they that buried Saul.
verses.sm: Ua o mai tagata O Iuta, ma latou faauu ia Tavita i lea mea e fai ma tupu o le aiga o Iuta. Ua taʻu atu foi ia Tavita, ua faapea, O tagata lapese-Kiliata na latou tanu ia Saulo.

verses.en: And David sent messengers unto the men of Jabesh-gilead, and said unto them, Blessed be ye of the LORD, that ye have shewed this kindness unto your lord, even unto Saul, and have buried him.
verses.sm: Ona aau atu lea e Tavita le sāvali i tagata o lapeseKiliata, ua faapea atu i ai, Ia manuia outou mai le ALII, auā na faapea ona outou agalelei i lo outou alii o Saulo; na outou teuteu foi ia te ia.

verses.en: And now the LORD shew kindness and truth unto you: and I also will requite you this kindness, because ye have done this thing.
verses.sm: O lenei, ia agalelei faamaoni le ALrr ia te outou; o aʻu foi, ou te taui atu ia te outou lenei mea lelei, ina ua outou faia lenei mea.

verses.en: Therefore now let your hands be strengthened, and be ye valiant: for your master Saul is dead, and also the house of Judah have anointed me king over them.
verses.sm: O lenei, ia outou lima malosi, ia fai foi ma tagata totoa; auā ua maliu lo outou alii o Saulo; a ua faauuina aʻu e le aiga o Iuta e fai ma tupu ia te i latou.

verses.en: But Abner the son of Ner, captain of Saul's host, took Ish-bosheth the son of Saul, and brought him over to Mahanaim;
verses.sm: A o Apineru le atalii o Neru le pule i ʻau sa ia Saulo, ua na ave ia Isoposeta le atalii o Saulo, ua la o atu ma ia i Maanaima.

verses.en: And made him king over Gilead, and over the Ashurites, and over Jezreel, and over Ephraim, and over Benjamin, and over all Israel.
verses.sm: Ua ia faia O ia ma tupu o Kiliata, ma sa Asuri, ma Isereelu, ma Efaraima, ma Peniamina, atoa ma Isaraelu uma lava.

verses.en: Ish-bosheth Saul's son was forty years old when he began to reign over Israel, and reigned two years. But the house of Judah followed David.
verses.sm: Ua fagafulu tausaga O Isoposeta le atalii o Saulo ina o fai O ia ma tupu o Isaraelu, na pule foi o ia i tausaga e lua; na o le aiga o Iuta sa mulimuli atu i latou ia Tavita.

verses.en: And the time that David was king in Hebron over the house of Judah was seven years and six months.
verses.sm: O le faitau O aso sa fai ai ma tupu Tavita i Heperona i le aiga o Iuta, ua fitu ona tausaga ma masina e ono.

verses.en: And Abner the son of Ner, and the servants of Ish-bosheth the son of Saul, went out from Mahanaim to Gibeon.
verses.sm: Ua o atu Apineru le atalii o Neru, ma auauna a Isoposeta le atalii o Saulo nai Maanaima i Kipeona.

verses.en: And Joab the son of Zeruiah, and the servants of David, went out, and met together by the pool of Gibeon: and they sat down, the one on the one side of the pool, and the other on the other side of the pool.
verses.sm: Ua o atu foi Ioapo le tama a Seruia, ma auauna a Tavita, ua latou fetaiai i le vailepa o Kipeona; ua nonofo i lalo, o i latou nei i le tasi itu o le vailepa, a o i latou ia i le tasi itu o le vailepa.

verses.en: And Abner said to Joab, Let the young men now arise, and play before us. And Joab said, Let them arise.
verses.sm: Ua fai mai Apineru ia Ioapo, Seʻi tulai taulelea, ia taaalo i o tatou luma; ua fai atu Ioapo, Ina latou tulai ia.

verses.en: Then there arose and went over by number twelve of Benjamin, which pertained to Ish-bosheth the son of Saul, and twelve of the servants of David.
verses.sm: Ona tulai lea, ma O atu e toasefulu ma le toalua e na faitauina o sa Peniaminā, o auauna a Isoposeta le atalii o Saulo; ma le toasefulu ma le toalua o auauna a Tavita.

verses.en: And they caught every one his fellow by the head, and thrust his sword in his fellow's side; so they fell down together: wherefore that place was called Helkath-hazzurim, which is in Gibeon.
verses.sm: Ua faatau ‘u‘u o latou ulu, ona faatau tutuʻi ai lea o latou itu i a latou pelu; ua oti faatasi ai i latou. Ua igoa ai lea mea, O le fanua o e malolosi, o loo i Kipeona.

verses.en: And there was a very sore battle that day; and Abner was beaten, and the men of Israel, before the servants of David.
verses.sm: Sa matuā tele lava le taua i lea aso; na tulia Apineru ma tagata o Isaraelu i luma o auauna a Tavita.

verses.en: And there were three sons of Zeruiah there, Joab, and Abishai, and Asahel: and Asahel was as light of foot as a wild roe.
verses.sm: Sa i ai tama tane e toatolu a Seruia, o Ioapo, ma Apisai, ma Asaelu; sa mama vae o Asaelu pei se sevi o le vao.

verses.en: And Asahel pursued after Abner; and in going he turned not to the right hand nor to the left from following Abner.
verses.sm: Ua tuliloa e Asaelu ia Apineru, ua le “alo ai o ia i le itu taumatau po o le itu tauagavale i lona mulimuli atu ia Apineru.

verses.en: Then Abner looked behind him, and said, Art thou Asahel? And he answered, I am.
verses.sm: Ua tepa Apineru i ona tua, ona fai mai lea o ia, O ce ea o Asaelu? Ua fai atu o ia, O aʻu lenei.

verses.en: And Abner said to him, Turn thee aside to thy right hand or to thy left, and lay thee hold on one of the young men, and take thee his armour. But Asahel would not turn aside from following of him.
verses.sm: Ona fai mai lea o Apineru ia te ia, Ina “alo ia i le itu taumatau po o le itu tauagavale, ma e pue se tasi taulealea, ma ave ana auupega mau. A ua le mafai Asaelu ona alu ese ia le mulimuli ia te ia.

verses.en: And Abner said again to Asahel, Turn thee aside from following me: wherefore should I smite thee to the ground? how then should I hold up my face to Joab thy brother?
verses.sm: Ona toe fai mai lea o Apineru ia Asaelu, Soia e te mulimuli mai ia te au; Ou te fasioti i se a ia te oe? ona faapefea lea ona ma toe feiloai ma Ioapo lou uso?

verses.en: Howbeit he refused to turn aside: wherefore Abner with the hinder end of the spear smote him under the fifth rib, that the spear came out behind him; and he fell down there, and died in the same place: and it came to pass, that as many as came to the place where Asahel fell down and died stood still.
verses.sm: A ua le mafai ia te ia ona “alo ese; ona tutu'i lea e Apineru ia te ia i le muli o le tao i lona manava, ua ati le tao i lona tua; ona pau ai lea o ia, ua oti i lea lava mea; o i latou uma ua 00 i le mea na pau ai Asaelu ma oti ai, ua tu ai i latou.

verses.en: Joab also and Abishai pursued after Abner: and the sun went down when they were come to the hill of Ammah, that lieth before Giah by the way of the wilderness of Gibeon.
verses.sm: A ua tulituliloa Ioapo ma Apisai ia Apineru; ua goto le la ina ua latou oo atu i le mauga o Ama, o loo i luma o Kia i le ala i le vao o Kipeona.

verses.en: And the children of Benjamin gathered themselves together after Abner, and became one troop, and stood on the top of an hill.
verses.sm: Ua faapotopoto atu foi le fanauga a Peniamina ia Apineru, ua fai ma “au e tasi; ona tutú lea o i latou i le tumutumu o le tasi mauga.

verses.en: Then Abner called to Joab, and said, Shall the sword devour for ever? knowest thou not that it will be bitterness in the latter end? how long shall it be then, ere thou bid the people return from following their brethren?
verses.sm: Ona valaau lea o Apineru ia Ioapo, ua faapea mai, E saga ‘ai pea ea le pelu? E te le iloa ea e iu ina oona? E te fai atu ea afea i le nuu, ia foi i latou aua le mulimuli atu i o latou uso?

verses.en: And Joab said, As God liveth, unless thou hadst spoken, surely then in the morning the people had gone up every one from following his brother.
verses.sm: Ua fai atu Ioapo, O loo soifua le Atua, ana e le fai mai, po ua taitasi ma alu ae le nuu i le taeao ai le mulimuli atu i o latou uso.

verses.en: So Joab blew a trumpet, and all the people stood still, and pursued after Israel no more, neither fought they any more.
verses.sm: Ona ili lea o le pu e Ioapo, ua tutù mai ai le nuu uma, ua le toe tulituliloa ia Isaraelu, ma ua le toe tau.

verses.en: And Abner and his men walked all that night through the plain, and passed over Jordan, and went through all Bithron, and they came to Mahanaim.
verses.sm: O Apineru ma ona tagata, ua savavali i latou i le eleele laugatasi ua a0 lava lea po; ua latou sopoia atu Ioritana, ma ui ane i Pitirona uma, ona 00 atu lea o i latou i Maanaima.

verses.en: And Joab returned from following Abner: and when he had gathered all the people together, there lacked of David's servants nineteen men and Asahel.
verses.sm: A ua foi atu Ioapo nai le tuliloaga o Apineru, ua ia faapotopotoina le nuu uma; o auauna a Tavita e lei i ai o tagata e toasefulu ma le toaiva, atoa ma Asaelu.

verses.en: But the servants of David had smitten of Benjamin, and of Abner's men, so that three hundred and threescore men died.
verses.sm: A o auauna a Tavita na latou fasia sa Peniaminá ma tagata o Apineru e toatolu galau ma te toaonogafulu ua oti.

verses.en: And they took up Asahel, and buried him in the sepulchre of his father, which was in Beth-lehem. And Joab and his men went all night, and they came to Hebron at break of day.
verses.sm: Ua latou avae ia Asaelu, ma tanu ia te ia i le tuugamau o lona tama o i Peteleema; ua atoa le po o savavali Ioapo ma ona tagata, ua aoina i latou i Heperona. Ua teva mai Apineru ia
